materials.label: Zenith Granum Crown
materials.note: one per Granum Void run; a few runs per Sister

conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The final showdown is locked behind Neptune Proxima; check the Railjack requirements before committing to a Sister.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: charged Requiem mods
rows.alt: trade duplicates or buy cheap mods from players

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional but very strong

conditions: Requiem Eterna Relics contain all eight Requiem mods at equal odds and cannot be refined with Void Traces.
Palladino also sells retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, capped at 10 per week.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and has three charges. It lets you reveal only two mods before testing the sequence.

disclosures.title: stock mods before spawning
disclosures.body: A new Sister is not removable until her three-Requiem sequence is solved. Have a usable Requiem pool first so the adversary does not become a roadblock.

groups.meta: up to 11 completed runs to force it

rows.label: Tenet Arca Plasmor Candidate
rows.note: weapon preview must say Tenet Arca Plasmor
rows.alt: buy a converted Tenet Arca Plasmor Sister from another player

rows.label: Heat progenitor
rows.note: Ember, Protea, Wisp, or another Heat frame
rows.alt: Cold or Electricity are strong second-status options

conditions: Capture the target, then spend a Zenith Crown at the Golden Hand and earn at least Rank 1 in Nightmare Granum Void (25 kills solo). The Candidate appears while extracting.
The downed Candidate previews her exact weapon before Mercy. Mercy only Tenet Arca Plasmor; the Warframe performing it fixes the progenitor element.
If the preview is wrong, leave her downed and complete the mission. That weapon leaves the 11-weapon cycle until every weapon has appeared; aborting does not advance the knockout cycle.
Do not run Steel Path for this: it gives identical Sister results with much tougher Granum enemies. A Candidate can flee, so chase her before extracting.
bonuses: Bring Xoris and stay near the fight: charged detonations on captive Solaris extend the Granum timer, and Errant Specters drop time triangles.

disclosures.title: make the weapon roll deterministic
disclosures.body: Pre-cycle unwanted Candidates before you need the gun. Refuse one, finish the mission, and repeat until Tenet Arca Plasmor is the only weapon left; then the next Candidate is guaranteed. A Golden Hand too near extraction can suppress the Candidate, so restart if the tile layout is bad.

groups.activity: Mercy Hounds, reveal mods, and test the sequence

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal mods, not their order

conditions: Parazon-Mercy the Sister's Hounds on her controlled nodes to gain Murmur and build rage. Each Sister stab also awards progress.
Wrong sequence attempts make her rank up and raise her territory's enemy levels, but they reveal sequence information and award a large Murmur bonus.
Stab her when she appears once you have a reasonable guess; waiting for all three reveals wastes encounters. A Requiem Ultimatum from Palladino force-spawns her regardless of rage.
bonuses: Oull in the third slot cuts the necessary reveal work roughly in half. Sisters have only three Hounds per mission and generally build rage quickly.

conditions: Kill the Sister's Hounds and two Warframe Specters before she can be damaged.
Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion gives a tradeable Sister contract and no weapon.
The weapon bypasses its normal Mastery Rank restriction when claimed, but it still requires its own weapon slot.
bonuses: The weapon arrives built; no crafting materials or Foundry timer are needed. Vanquishing also has a 25% chance to award Oull.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 × the higher bonus, 60%). Any result at 58% or higher rounds to 60%.
Start fusion from the copy you want to keep. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, Focus lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
If the elements differ, choose the one to preserve. Elemental Vice can later change element after rank 40 (five Forma), but never the percentage.
bonuses: A displayed 52.8% or higher donor or recipient reaches 60% in one fusion.

disclosures.title: a 60% roll means repeat Sisters
disclosures.body: From the 25% floor, a 60% result can take up to nine fusions. Keep the first functional weapon and treat maxing the bonus as a separate, long-term goal.
